upload.title: Drop a document
upload.add_title: Add a document to the project
upload.lead: CSV, Excel, PDF (including scanned), Word, text, JSON or an image of a table. No need to clean the file first.
upload.drop: Drag and drop your files here
upload.formats_supported: Supported formats: {{formats}}. Tables and explicitly present data are extracted; nothing is invented.
upload.formats_refused: Refused: executables, archives (zip, 7z…), macro files (xlsm, docm…), password-protected files, other formats. No macro, script, external link or PDF action is ever executed.
upload.limits: Limits: {{max_file_mib}} MiB per file, {{max_rows}} rows, {{max_cols}} columns, {{max_pdf_pages}} PDF pages, {{max_ocr_pages}} OCR pages. Beyond that, the import is refused or a page selection is offered.
upload.privacy: Files stay on this computer until the project is deleted. No telemetry.
upload.ocr_missing: OCR unavailable (Tesseract not found): scanned PDFs and images cannot be read.

projects.title: Saved projects
projects.confirm_delete: Permanently delete project “{{name}}” (sources, derived data, results)?

next_action.default: Check the file or try another format (CSV or Excel).
next_action.no_table_found_pdf: No usable table or numeric value was found. Export the source as CSV/Excel if possible.
next_action.no_data_found_text: The document contains no table and no “label: number” values. Add a data file.
next_action.image_unreadable: Unreadable image. Provide a sharper capture (at least 150 dpi) or the original file.
next_action.image_no_table: No table detected in the image. Provide the original file.
next_action.too_many_pages: Enter the pages to process below.
next_action.too_many_ocr_pages: Enter the scanned pages to read below.
next_action.protected_file: Remove the password protection in the original software, then import again.
next_action.macro_file_refused: Save the workbook as .xlsx (without macros), then import again.
next_action.unsupported_format: Use one of the formats listed below.
next_action.encoding_unknown: Save the file again as UTF-8.
next_action.file_too_large: Split or filter the file before importing.
next_action.too_many_rows: Split the file (e.g. by period) or raise the KPI_MAX_ROWS limit.
next_action.too_many_columns: Remove unneeded columns or raise the KPI_MAX_COLS limit.
next_action.json_unsupported_structure: The JSON must be a list of objects or contain such a list.
next_action.ocr_unavailable: Install Tesseract (the setup script does it) or provide a text/Excel file.
